sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Fruits and Vegetables Development Board Repeal Ordinance 2001
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE II OF 2001
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE FRUITS AND VEGETABLES DEVELOPMENT BOARD (REPEAL) ORDINANCE,
2001
ORDINANCE II OF 2001
An Ordinance
further to repeal the North-West Frontier Province Fruits and Vegetables
Development Board Ordinance, 1984
[Gazette of N.-W.F.P.,
Extraordinary, 31st January, 2001]
No. Legis.1(3)/82-II/617,
dated 31-1-2001. The following Ordinance by the Governor of the North-West
Frontier Province is hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called the North-West Frontier
Province Fruits and Vegetables Development Board (Repeal) Ordinance, 2001.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

2. Definitions.--In this
Ordinance, unless the context otherwise requires, the following expressions
shall have the meanings hereby respectively assigned to them, that is to say---
(a)
"Board" means the Fruits and Vegetables Development Board constituted
under the North-West Frontier Province Fruits and Vegetables Development Board
Ordinance, 1984 (N.-W.F.P. Ord. No. I of 1984);
(b)
"Government" means the Government of the North-West Frontier
Province.

sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Fruits and Vegetables Development Board Repeal Ordinance 2001
sections.description:
Transfer of assets and liabilities of the Board

ORDINANCE II OF 2001
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE FRUITS AND VEGETABLES DEVELOPMENT BOARD (REPEAL) ORDINANCE,
2001
ORDINANCE II OF 2001
An Ordinance
further to repeal the North-West Frontier Province Fruits and Vegetables
Development Board Ordinance, 1984
[Gazette of N.-W.F.P.,
Extraordinary, 31st January, 2001]
No. Legis.1(3)/82-II/617,
dated 31-1-2001. The following Ordinance by the Governor of the North-West
Frontier Province is hereby published for general information:--
3. Transfer of assets and
liabilities of the Board.---(1) As from the coming into force of this
Ordinance,--
(a) all
horticultural staff alongwith posts, budgets, assets and facilities,
transferred to the Board under section 16(b) of the Ordinance being repealed
hereunder and all other assets created by the Board shall stand transferred to,
and vest in, the Extension Wing of the Agriculture Department of Government.
(b) golden shake
hand will be given to regular employees of the Board from the reserve fund of
the Board, according to rules;
(c) services of
the contract employees of the Board shall stand terminated in accordance with
the terms and conditions of their service; and
(d) all debts,
liabilities and obligations incurred, contracts entered into, and all matters
and things engaged to be done by, with or for, and all suits and other
proceedings by or against, the Board, shall be deemed to be debts, liabilities
and obligations incurred, contracts entered into, or, as the case may be,
matters and things engaged to be done by, with or for, and suits and other
proceedings by or against the Government.
(2) Notwithstanding the
provisions of clause (b) of subsection (1), a small unit of the Board, as
determined by Government, which shall not be more than six to eight persons,
may be allowed to work for sometime for the disposal of pending business of the
defunct Board.

[Gazette of N.-W.F.P.,

No. Legis.1(3)/82-II/617,
dated 31-1-2001. The following Ordinance by the Governor of the North-West
Frontier Province is hereby published for general information:--
4. Supplementary powers.--For
the purposes of carrying into effect the provisions of this Ordinance,
Government may, in such manner as it may deem necessary or expedient, provide
for---
(a) the removal
of difficulties arising out of, or in connection with, the dissolution of the
Board; and
(b) other matters
supplemental, or incidental to, or consequential upon, the dissolution of the
Board.

No. Legis.1(3)/82-II/617,

5. Repeal and Dissolution:--The
North-West Frontier Province Fruits and Vegetables Development Board Ordinance,

established under the repealed Ordinance shall stand dissolved.
